sourceState: Uncommitted changes in the coordinator checkout; coordinator owns integration and CI.
levelMeaning: These flags describe evidence collected by Agent B for this new source package, not prior QA127 or later coordinator execution.

changes.problem: A new controller could read an empty journal while an older native write was still pending before visibility; late cleanup could similarly overlap the replacement controller.
changes.fix: Serialize only journal reads/writes/removals by existing account+Agreement key, across controller instances. Check the current owner before queued writes/removals. Keep all network calls outside the queue.
invariants: No automatic message send or retry
Only the existing four identity/hash fields are persisted

changes.problem: NUL and lone UTF-16 surrogate code points passed local validation and could capture a journal for a payload rejected by text transport/storage.
changes.fix: Reject invalid text before journal or RPC, retain the editable input, and show a bounded formal error. Preserve valid Serbian scripts, combining marks and emoji pairs.

changes.problem: Ordinary Need sends were fenced by account/focus/view but not the foreground generation; a stale callback or a delayed journal completion could start a new send after backgrounding.
changes.fix: Include the existing foreground generation in isCurrent and canSubmit. Pending identity and text remain for canonical recovery; returning to foreground does not revive the old command.
invariants: No new paid model call in the retired scope
Fresh user action in the new foreground still dispatches once

changes.fix: Existing group-screen labels and accessible actions use Vi/Vam. The support hint correctly describes selecting a message for a report, not already sending a report.

negativeControls.test: group: returning before a journal write becomes visible waits for its identity instead of admitting a fresh command
negativeControls.before: FAIL: actual READY, expected LOADING while the older write had not become visible.
negativeControls.after: PASS; retains original identity, waits for persistence, reconciles without sending, and permits only explicit same-key retry.

negativeControls.test: group: invalid text never captures a journal; the editable draft and valid Serbian/emoji text are preserved
negativeControls.before: FAIL: draftSendable was true for an invalid NUL-containing input.
negativeControls.after: PASS for NUL and both lone-surrogate forms; valid mixed Serbian text and family emoji send normally.

negativeControls.test: Need: ordinary send captured before background cannot create a turn after foreground returns
negativeControls.before: FAIL: journalSave was called by the callback captured before the foreground transition.
negativeControls.after: PASS; no journalSave, no sendMessage, no replacement ID; text remains.

negativeControls.test: Need: background while persisting an ordinary turn keeps its journal and draft without starting the provider
negativeControls.before: FAIL: sendMessage was called after backgrounding while journal persistence had been pending.
negativeControls.after: PASS both while still backgrounded and after returning active; same journal and text remain and canSend stays false until recovery.

finalReview.scope: nova.tsx, GroupConversationPresentation.tsx, GroupConversationScreen.tsx, and the shared PillComposer/ConfirmSheet boundaries used by those changes.
react: No new conditional hooks or hook-order changes.
Existing stable confirmation.close callback keeps the foreground subscription stable.
Foreground invalidation changes the owner ref and schedules a render; only a real inactive/active transition creates a new owner.
Need callbacks capture their rendered owner, retain account-revision/focus/view checks, and cannot revive after a foreground transition.
Group changes preserve account/revision/Agreement/group ownership and do not change list identity, navigation or existing viewability dependencies.
accessibility: Invalid group text has a visible alert with polite live-region behavior.
The disabled send button retains an accessible reason and disabled state through PillComposer.
Input, send, retry and support selection have formal action labels.
Existing 48-pixel command targets and layout remain unchanged.
limits: Source review and local mounted React fixtures only.
No TalkBack run, native keyboard check, screen-size rendering or on-device timing measurement.

coldProcessTextContract.groupJournalParser: src/data/groupConversationService.ts: parseGroupJournal requires exactly those four fields.
coldProcessTextContract.groupJournalWriter: src/ui/groups/GroupConversationController.ts: IDs/hash are written before send; no body is persisted.
coldProcessTextContract.groupDraftLifetime: src/ui/groups/GroupConversationScreen.tsx: heldDraft is React ref memory scoped by account/revision/Agreement/group. It cannot survive process death.
coldProcessTextContract.previousEvidence: docs/plan/proofs/autonomous-source-20261110.json explicitly records warm-memory-only text retention and IDs/hash-only disk journal.

protections: Explicit-logout cleanup via forgetAgreementOutboxes from authClientService
existingDurableTextFacility.reason: It is coupled to AgreementMessageCommand, agreementId, private-message receipts and private outbox lifecycle. Group journal and receipts have different identity and replay semantics.

coldProcessTextContract.otherDraftCaches: applicationComposerDraftMemory.ts and agreementUnsentDraft.ts explicitly store text in process RAM only.
coldProcessTextContract.conclusion: The current group contract is IDs/hash only, but this is not a product-wide prohibition on persistent draft text. No existing generic or group-specific durable text store was found that can be reused unchanged. The private Agreement implementation provides an existing pattern for a later scoped integration; it has not been connected to group conversations here.
coldProcessTextContract.remainingGap: Unsent or unconfirmed group text is not preserved through Android process death. Server-confirmed messages may be recovered from authoritative history; an unknown journal can require exact re-entry. Android process-kill acceptance remains open.

pushReview.diagnosticFinding: An HTTP-200 receipt body stream rejection was initially classified invalid rather than transport. Reproduced with the real handler fixture; zero SEND calls.
pushReview.coordinatorResolutionReviewed: Dedicated StreamReadFailure wraps reader.read rejection only; UTF-8/JSON errors stay invalid; timeout/body-network scenarios are in the existing outage regression.

runtimeLimits.reason: No Android runtime was available. CI, DEV rollout and full user/server acceptance are coordinator-owned subsequent evidence.
